package io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.phase1;

import io.github.dsheirer.dsp.symbol.Dibit;
import io.github.dsheirer.message.DroppedSamplesMessage;
import io.github.dsheirer.message.IMessage;
import io.github.dsheirer.message.SyncLossMessage;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.DecoderType;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.FeedbackDecoder;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.phase1.message.P25P1Message;
import io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.phase1.message.tsbk.TSBKMessage;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Runs the real P25P1DemodulatorC4FM and the real P25P1MessageFramer over synthetic dibit streams (from the Rust
 * stream generator, fixtures/p25_streams.txt) and records every message the framer broadcasts.
 * Usage: java ...GenFramer p25_streams.txt out.txt
 *
 * Output line: FRAMER|stream|mode|events   events separated by ';' (see record())
 */
public class GenFramer {
    static final float SPS = 25000f / 4800f;
    static final long REFERENCE_TIME = 1_000_000L;

    static FeedbackDecoder stubDecoder() {
        return new FeedbackDecoder() {
            @Override public String getProtocolDescription() { return "stub"; }
            @Override public DecoderType getDecoderType() { return DecoderType.P25_PHASE1; }
            @Override public void reset() { }
            @Override public void start() { }
            @Override public void stop() { }
            @Override public void dispose() { }
            @Override public void setMessageListener(io.github.dsheirer.sample.Listener<IMessage> l) { }
            @Override public void removeMessageListener() { }
        };
    }

    static String bits(io.github.dsheirer.bits.BinaryMessage m) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < m.size(); i++) sb.append(m.get(i) ? '1' : '0');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    static String record(IMessage m) {
        if (m instanceof TSBKMessage t) {
            return "T," + t.getDUID().name() + "," + ((io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.identifier.APCO25Nac) t.getNAC()).getValue()
                + "," + t.getTimestamp() + "," + (t.isValid() ? 1 : 0) + "," + (t.isLastBlock() ? 1 : 0) + ","
                + t.getMessage().getCorrectedBitCount() + "," + bits(t.getMessage());
        }
        if (m instanceof P25P1Message p) {
            return "U," + p.getDUID().name() + "," + ((io.github.dsheirer.module.decode.p25.identifier.APCO25Nac) p.getNAC()).getValue()
                + "," + p.getTimestamp() + "," + p.getMessage().getCorrectedBitCount() + "," + bits(p.getMessage());
        }
        if (m instanceof SyncLossMessage s) return "L," + s.getTimestamp() + "," + s.getBitsProcessed();
        if (m instanceof DroppedSamplesMessage d) return "D," + d.getTimestamp() + "," + d.getBitsDropped();
        return "?," + m.getClass().getSimpleName();
    }

    static float[] render(int[] symbols, Random r, double gain, double pll, double noise, double start) {
        double sps = 25000.0 / 4800.0;
        int n = (int) ((symbols.length - 2 - start) * sps);
        float[] out = new float[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            double x = i / sps + start;
            int k = (int) Math.floor(x);
            double f = x - k, w = (1 - Math.cos(Math.PI * f)) / 2;
            double p0 = Dibit.fromValue(symbols[k]).getIdealPhase(), p1 = Dibit.fromValue(symbols[k + 1]).getIdealPhase();
            out[i] = (float) ((p0 * (1 - w) + p1 * w) * gain + pll + r.nextGaussian() * noise);
        }
        return out;
    }

    static void run(PrintWriter out, String name, String mode, float[] samples) {
        P25P1MessageFramer framer = new P25P1MessageFramer();
        List<String> events = new ArrayList<>();
        framer.setListener(m -> events.add(record(m)));
        if (mode.startsWith("expected:")) framer.setExpectedNAC(Integer.parseInt(mode.substring(9), 16));
        if (mode.equals("strict")) framer.setRequireValidNID(true);
        framer.setTimestamp(REFERENCE_TIME);
        framer.start();
        P25P1DemodulatorC4FM demod = new P25P1DemodulatorC4FM(framer, stubDecoder());
        demod.setSamplesPerSymbol(SPS);
        if (mode.startsWith("expected:")) demod.setExpectedNAC(Integer.parseInt(mode.substring(9), 16));
        if (mode.equals("strict")) demod.setRequireValidNID(true);
        int[] sizes = {1000, 513, 2048, 77, 300, 1024, 999};
        int pos = 0, step = 0;
        while (pos < samples.length) {
            int n = Math.min(sizes[step++ % sizes.length], samples.length - pos);
            demod.process(Arrays.copyOfRange(samples, pos, pos + n));
            pos += n;
        }
        out.println("FRAMER|" + name + "|" + mode + "|" + String.join(";", events));
    }

    static void signal(PrintWriter out, String id, float[] samples) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) sb.append(i > 0 ? "," : "").append(Integer.toHexString(Float.floatToRawIntBits(samples[i])));
        out.println("SIGNAL|" + id + "|" + sb);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(args[1]));
        long seed = 100;
        for (String line : Files.readAllLines(Paths.get(args[0]))) {
            String[] f = line.split("\\|");
            int[] symbols = new int[f[2].length()];
            for (int i = 0; i < symbols.length; i++) symbols[i] = f[2].charAt(i) - '0';
            float[] clean = render(symbols, new Random(seed++), 0.83, 0.07, 0.03, 0.3);
            signal(out, f[1] + "-clean", clean);
            run(out, f[1] + "-clean", "plain", clean);
            run(out, f[1] + "-clean", "strict", clean);
            run(out, f[1] + "-clean", "expected:293", clean);
            run(out, f[1] + "-clean", "expected:1F1", clean);
            float[] noisy = render(symbols, new Random(seed++), 0.9, 0.2, 0.09, 0.71);
            signal(out, f[1] + "-noisy", noisy);
            run(out, f[1] + "-noisy", "plain", noisy);
            run(out, f[1] + "-noisy", "strict", noisy);
        }
        out.close();
    }
}
